title: Just OK so far.
text: The first "toy" was very mediocre; basically it was a few pieces of cardboard flashcards with not a whole lot of thought put into it. Not worth $20.  Not even worth $5.  The second was quite good; my niece and nephew enjoyed it quite a bit. A building toy that lets them lets them learn mechanical thinking; the kind of thing I would expect. Averaging out the 1 star item with the 5 star item I'll give it a 3. If the next impresses, I'll revise the review.
label: neutral
